title: 🔀 Router for R-1 mini RL 299 (paused until new R-1)
text: Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/41c4a78a1c87813d981ff3cab9633dcf as of 2026-11-19T01:51:38.387Z: {"Category":"fast-inference","Last edited":"2026-11-19T01:51:38.387Z","Name":"Router for R-1 mini RL 299 (paused until new R-1)","Priority":"p0","Status":"Not started","date:Period:end":"2026-11-20","date:Period:is_datetime":0,"date:Period:start":"2026-11-18","url":"https://app.notion.com/p/41c4a78a1c87813d981ff3cab9633dcf"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🔀"} Goal. By Fri 11/20, pick the page router for R-1 mini RL 299 (reducto/fpp_2b_rl299_jev_20261117@153ee1ac, Modal dev shadow rl299, [#15274](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/15274)). Retrain the route head ([#14939](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/14939)) and the old router (fpp_router_0913) the way each was first trained, then compare them offline and in autoeval. Every candidate gets at least 24 h of autoeval. US, EU and AU roll out together; Jean decides and deploys. Non-goal: new router designs. Jean's two calls (with the stamp; defaults in place) 1. Fallback for Yifei's data. His 83k pages and labels are not in S3. If they are not found by Wed night (PT), we retrain the old router on the route head's 20.5k pages, with 3-class labels from the same Astra scores. That changes how it was trained, so it needs your OK. Without it, the old router is compared only as shipped. 2. Which R-1 defines "big". Default: prod R-1 (1112). The stored R-1 parses come from reducto_fpp35b_rl1027_6m, so 1112 means re-parsing the R-1 side too, about 2x the parse cost. # Plan - Recipe PR (route head): rebase onto the training scaffold, add --checkpoint - Exit check: the 20261028 checkpoint and the recovered data reproduce 8d891b9a (at least 99.5% decision match at 0.58 on the 2,000 ParseArena pages) - Relabel the route head for RL 299 (Wed) - Parse the 20,486 pages on rl299, judge each against its stored R-1 parse with Astra (\~0.5 B200-h, 20.5k calls) - Reuse the chart labels (image only); prefill features from the RL 299 bf16 checkpoint (\~1 H100-h) - Train and export the route head (Thu AM) - Same Huber loss, 60 epochs, weight decay chosen on held-out documents, CPU minutes; int8 export and HF upload - Retrain the old router (Thu AM) - Relabel Yifei's 88k pages with RL 299 as "small" (\~2.5 B200-h and 88k Astra calls, the largest cost; fallback is a 30k subset) - Train with the 0913 config on 4×H200 (a few hours): 3 epochs, keep the best validation checkpoint (epoch 2 last time); calibrate the threshold on val - Offline comparison on the 2,000 ParseArena pages, never trained on (Thu AM) - Arms: always mini, always R-1, shipped route head, retrained route head, shipped old router, retrained old router - Metrics: score at 40% and 50% routed, \$/1k pages (mini \$1, R-1 \$10), Pareto plot, chart recall - Autoeval the best one or two on RL 299 for at least 24 h (must start Thu PM) - Route head through the b200-route image variant; old router through the bs-router shadow relay - Prod (Fri PM): Jean's call and deploy, US, EU and AU together # Logs - Route head - Inputs recovered (from Raunak's session): s3://reducto-shared-ml-workspace/jean/handoff/20261115.route-head/ holds the 20,486 training pages with R-1 mini parse, R-1 parse and Astra scores; chart labels and prefill features; 2,000 ParseArena pages; the fp32 head and original scripts - Export verified: the recipe's int8 export of the fp32 head matches the shipped head 8d891b9a tensor for tensor - Recipe on a local branch, not pushed: src/hacky/training/recipes/route_head (about 570 lines: select, label, features, train, int8 export, decision match check); a unit test shows the serving Router reads its export - Old router - Found in registry/prod/fpp_router_0913.yaml: Qwen3.5-0.8B, rank-32 LoRA, vision frozen; labels a page small, neither or big from the image alone, routes to big when P(big) minus P(small) > 0.4196 - Trained on 83,437 train and 5,003 val pages, CE loss, batch 128, lr 1e-4, 3 epochs (best validation checkpoint: epoch 2), 4×H200; run /workspace/home/yifei/.../router_0910_batch_sweep_20260913, weights on Modal volume v2_checkpoints_yifei - Training pages and labels not in S3; asking Yifei - Wed 11/18: plan sent for Jean's stamp - Wed 11/18: Jean paused the retrain until the new R-1 version lands # Impact The retrain is paused until the new R-1 lands, so there is no after yet. The baseline is existing measurements; every after cell is pending. ## Baseline (before the retrain) | Metric | Value | Source | | --- | --- | --- | | GPU cost per 1k router calls, US prod (Oct 15 to 21) | \$0.371 | [fpp\_router\_serving RESULTS.md, Prod baseline](https://github.com/reductoai/api/blob/main/src/hacky/inference/workstreams/2026/10/22/fpp_router_serving/RESULTS.md) | | GPU cost per 1k router calls, EU (Oct 15 to 21) | \$3.474 | same | | Router Modal spend, US prod / EU | \$1,814/day / \$220/day | same | | Client p50 / p90 / p99, US prod | 269 / 561 / 1,616 ms | same | | Client p50 / p90 / p99, EU | 427 / 1,177 / 3,847 ms | same | | Timeouts per 1k calls, US prod / EU | 0.64 / 0.39 | same | | Containers, US prod / EU | 32.0 / 5.1 | same | | Utilization, 1 router process per H100 | GPU under 40% busy; about 120 ms CPU per page | [fpp\_router\_serving README](https://github.com/reductoai/api/blob/main/src/hacky/inference/workstreams/2026/10/22/fpp_router_serving/README.md) | | Serving change already shipped (2 processes per H100, target 48) | about 41% less \$/day in the replay | same | These October numbers predate the 2-process change, so re-measure the baseline from prod (bill and Tinybird) the week before the retrain ships. ## After (retrained router) | Metric | Value | | --- | --- | | GPU cost per 1k pages | pending (retrain paused) | | Modal spend | pending | | p99 | pending | | Fallbacks (pages routed off R-1) | pending; no baseline measured yet | | Utilization | pending | | Training cost of the retrain | pending (ledger: python -m hacky.training status) | The SQLite table definition for this page's parent data source.
